g.title: legend
g.text: Dashed red, from every waiting state: the reply never came.
A command's ack: three resends 500 ms apart, then faulted.
An expected event (HOMED, TARGET, RELEASED, TRIAL): 10 s late, then faulted.
Any ev FAULT or any nak, in any state: faulted.
